invariants.text: categories.id must be a positive integer and auto-incremented
categories.name must be a non-null string and unique
products.id must be a positive integer and auto-incremented
products.name must be a non-null string
products.description must be nullable
products.price must be a positive integer (in cents) and nullable if description is provided
products.category_id must reference an existing category.id
products.stock_quantity must be a non-negative integer
customers.id must be a positive integer and auto-incremented
customers.name must be a non-null string
customers.email must be a non-null string and unique
customers.phone must be nullable
orders.id must be a positive integer and auto-incremented
orders.customer_id must reference an existing customer.id
orders.status must be one of ['pending', 'confirmed', 'shipped', 'cancelled']
orders.created_at must be a non-null timestamp
orders.updated_at must be a non-null timestamp
order_items.id must be a positive integer and auto-incremented
order_items.order_id must reference an existing order.id
order_items.product_id must reference an existing product.id
order_items.quantity must be a positive integer
order_items.unit_price must match products.price when order_items.product_id is referenced
order_items.unit_price must be a positive integer (in cents)
invoices.id must be a positive integer and auto-incremented
invoices.order_id must reference an existing order.id
invoices.customer_id must reference an existing customer.id
invoices.invoice_number must be a non-null string and unique
invoices.total_amount must match the sum of order_items.unit_price * order_items.quantity for the referenced order
invoices.total_amount must be a positive integer (in cents)
invoices.created_at must be a non-null timestamp
An order can only be confirmed if its status is 'pending'
An order's status must be updated to 'confirmed' when an invoice is created for it
An order's status must be updated to 'shipped' only after it is confirmed
An order's status cannot be 'cancelled' if it is 'confirmed' or 'shipped'
When an order is confirmed, products.reserved_stock must be deducted from products.stock_quantity for each order_item.product_id
When an order is cancelled and its status is 'confirmed', products.reserved_stock must be released back to products.stock_quantity for each order_item.product_id
